maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are arranged in a horizontal line, spaced at intervals approximately 1.5 times their own diameter, and situated roughly 20 pixels superior to the primary dense row with a parallel orientation.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 95% melanin saturation; the rhinarium is almost entirely composed of low-value, dark pixels with negligible pink/pale pixelation observed at this resolution.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple small, high-contrast dark clusters on the lateral neck region consistent with ectoparasites. Subtle irregular notch on the superior-leading edge of the right ear pinna.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white sub-orbital fur patches creating a high-contrast boundary with the tawny facial fur.
